html:
Run a finger along the top of a door frame in a house that was renovated last week. If it comes back gray, the final clean is not done. That test is how we start a walkthrough for post construction cleaning near I-85 in Greer, and it is what a builder or homeowner can use to judge any cleaning, ours or anyone else's.

What a final walkthrough should show

Homes near I-85 in Greer include new builds and renovations, and both end the same way: a person with a clipboard or a set of keys opens the door. Use this list when you walk through.

  • Top of door frames, window sills and the ledge of every baseboard are free of dust
  • Inside cabinets and drawers, with no sawdust in the corners
  • Light fixtures, vents and ceiling fans wiped
  • Glass has no labels, paint specks or adhesive on it
  • Window tracks are clear
  • Bathroom fixtures are polished and the tub or shower has no film
  • Floors are clean at the edges and under where tools were stored

If any of those fail, the job needs another pass. Our post construction cleaning in Greer includes a touch-up pass for that reason.

Dust is not all the same

Knowing what is on the surface changes the order of work, the cloths and the tools, so we look before we start.

This is the part most people do not expect. A crew plans the work around what the construction left behind.

What was leftWhere it hidesHow we handle it
Drywall dustLedges, vents, tops of cabinets, tracksTop-down, lifted rather than pushed around
Paint specks and dripsGlass, sills, tile, hardwareCareful removal that avoids scratching the surface
Sticker and film adhesiveNew windows, appliances, fixturesSoftened and removed, then the surface is cleaned
Grit and debrisFloors, corners, stairsMultiple vacuum and wash passes

Drywall sanding creates the most fine dust, and that dust gets into return vents and onto ceiling fans, where it comes back later if nobody cleaned it.

Greer spans Greenville and Spartanburg counties and sits along I-85, SC-14, SC-101 and US-29. For our team, a job near the highway is a short drive from our home base. For you, it often means the construction schedule is tied to a closing date or a family move. The cleaning method does not change with the address, but the schedule often does, so we ask about the deadline first.

Check the full list on the post-construction cleaning services page, then book a free estimate for post-construction cleaning in Greer and walk your project with us before the clean begins.What to ask any cleaner before you hire

Whoever you choose, ask a few direct questions. Do they walk the project first? Do they clean top to bottom? Do they work in more than one pass on floors? Will they come back for a touch-up if something is missed? A company that answers yes to these has done this kind of job before. If an answer is vague, keep looking.

For builders managing several jobs at once, it also helps to ask about timing. A general contractor with a closing on Friday needs a plan for the rough clean on Tuesday and the final clean on Thursday, with the touch-up before the buyer arrives. We can book these stages together so one crew knows the house from start to finish.

Take your walkthrough in daylight, with the blinds open and the lights on. Glare shows streaks on glass and film on tile that a dim room hides, and it is the same light a buyer or inspector will see.

Homeowners who stay in the house during a remodel have a different problem: dust gets into rooms nobody expected. Tell us which areas you used, and we will include them. Closets, laundry rooms and hallways near the work zone are the places that surprise people most.

faqs: What should I look at in a final walkthrough after construction?
Check ledges, door frames, cabinet interiors, glass, window tracks and floor edges in daylight. Gray dust on a finger means another pass is needed.
Do you remove stickers and paint specks?
Yes. Paint specks, sticker residue and adhesive are part of the service, handled carefully to avoid scratches.
Can you meet a closing deadline near I-85 in Greer?
We plan around your date after a walkthrough. A tight closing may need a larger team, and we confirm that when we see the project.
